name: Latent Labs
tagline: Browser-based generative AI for push-button protein design.
description: Latent Labs builds frontier generative AI models for molecular biology, delivered through a no-code web platform. Its Latent-X model designs de novo protein binders — mini-binders and macrocycles — directly in the browser, letting scientists upload a target and generate candidates without specialized infrastructure. The platform is in early access.
insight: Founded by Simon Kohl, a co-developer of DeepMind's Nobel-winning AlphaFold; launched its web-based Latent-X model in July 2025.
edge: Puts frontier protein-binder design in a no-code browser app — lab-validated hit rates without the HPC setup most de novo design tools require.

references.title: Latent Labs launches web-based AI model to democratize protein design
